defects.title: The random warm start is not protected against infinite bounds
defects.trigger: problem with lb = [-inf; -inf] (p = 2, A = [1 1], b = 1, 'E', ub = [2; 2], c = 0), rng(1), param.printLevel = 1
defects.observed: (R2025a, gurobi, 2026-11-23) start is -Inf where lb is -Inf (line 747 uses lb2, not the clipped minlb2 of lines 742-745); first iteration prints ||dx|| = Inf, del_obj = NaN; result unaffected (stat 1, obj 1)
defects.expected: a finite random start between minlb2 and maxub2

defects.title: A missing q, r, b or csense stops with MATLAB's error instead of the function's message
Boolean p, q and r whose lengths differ in one pair only pass the size check
The size warning of the one-norm weight vector o names d

notes: Fixed by feature 20261125-161147-blocker-fixes-two (maintainer approval 2026-11-25, decision 1): line 912 (906 before the NOTE) 'case 1 || 3', which is 'case true' and matched stat 1 only, is now 'case {1, 3}', so an LP status 3 of a sub-problem continues the iterations as the sub-problem (line 1165) and the final report (line 1065) already did; solution.stat is 3 when the last sub-problem returned 3. Dated NOTE in the help (6 lines, so every line after 110 moved by 6). The quarantine defect entry is removed; the cosmetic warm-start defect stays recorded (not part of the approved fix; its input is not used). Full test written test-first: on the old code it failed at assert(solution.stat == 3) (stand-in solveCobraLP returning stat 3: old code returned stat -1 and the start point after one sub-problem). Passes with gurobi and with glpk. Stand-ins for solveCobraLP and solveCobraQP in a tempname folder first on the path give statuses -1, 0, 2, 3, 4 (unknown), the l1/l2 warm-start statuses, the feasibility-check branches and a complementarity violation. Exempt lines are unreachable code: dead 'if 0' / '&& 0' / '& 0' blocks and the else of 'if 1', statements after error, checks that an earlier statement makes unreachable (missing q, r, b, csense fail earlier; lb > ub returns earlier; line 168 duplicate default; lines 236-237 inner check of a scalar p; lines 252-253 a non-scalar && operand raises MATLAB's own error). Not graded as defects (observations kept from the back-fill record): the documented warning-and-stat -1 checks for missing b/csense cannot run; lines 252-253 cannot give their message; 'ltp~=ltq && ltq~=ltr' (line 240) would be || ; the size check of o for the scalar form names d in its message (line 404).
